summary: Backend-only validation of the GTEC C5 Executive Compliance Report v2 (3-page redesign). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_gtec_c5_executive_pdf_v2.py (12 permanent tests) covering bundle build from real DB report via motor, 3-page structural validation (executive verdict + runtime enforcement + §12/§13 appendix), PASS/FAIL synthetic variants, trend helper (returns <=7 rows oldest→newest excluding current task_id, returns [] when MONGO_URL missing), email dispatch wiring (send_catalog_template monkeypatched — no real email), and /api/health smoke. All 12 tests pass. Also re-ran the 7 mandated regression suites: 85/85 passed. The 2 pre-existing order-flaky enterprise workflow tests verified passing in isolation as noted by the reviewer.

flaky_isolated_reruns.results: 2 passed in isolation (order flakiness NOT a new regression)

verified_contracts.bundle: guardrail_passed=True, guardrail_failures=[], filename matches rac-compliance-v15-gtec-c5-<taskid>-<UTC ts>Z.pdf, sha256 64-hex, pdf_bytes start %PDF-1.4 and end %%EOF, base64 attachment decodes back to same bytes
verified_contracts.brand_marker: RealAICoach Security present in extracted text
verified_contracts.page1_images: >=2 images embedded (logo tile + QR code) — verified via PyMuPDF get_images
verified_contracts.variants: PASS and FAIL variants each render 3 pages and show correct verdict text on page 1
verified_contracts.trend_helper: returns <=7 rows sorted oldest→newest, excludes current task_id, keys {status, trust_percent, generated_at}; returns [] when MONGO_URL env var is missing (monkeypatched)
verified_contracts.email_wiring: _email_report_to_admins forwards bundle.attachment to send_catalog_template(template_key='gtec_scan_v2_report', attachments=[...], pdf_attachment_name=..., pdf_guardrail_passed=True). Base64 attachment content decodes to a valid %PDF-1.4 blob.

critical_code_review_comments: _render_gtec_final_output_pdf uses ReportLab (heavy) — file gtec_scan_v2.py is now ~5863 lines. Consider extracting the PDF renderer + trend helper into services/gtec_c5_pdf.py to enforce <700 loc modules. Not blocking.

_fetch_gtec_c5_trend_rows opens/closes a fresh sync pymongo client on every PDF render. Fine for best-effort correctness (avoids motor loop-binding), but if PDFs are generated in tight bulk loops the 3s server-selection timeout could be a latency ceiling. Could cache trend rows for the report by task_id if needed later.

Guardrail set is comprehensive (pdf_header_v14, logo image, RealAICoach Security heading, §12, §13). Suggest adding a `qr_image_present` guardrail explicitly (currently guaranteed only by count-of-images heuristic on page1) so the QR deep-link contract is enforceable at guardrail level.

Filename slugger converts underscores to dashes — task_id 'gtec_c5_96f226bdf937' becomes 'gtec-c5-96f226bdf937'. Contract tests updated to match. This is a hidden change vs raw task_id: OK because filename uses to_public_task_id which normalizes anyway.
